## Invitations

A total of 2421 invitations were issued during the reporting period. Attendance was recorded at 510, representing an attendance rate of 21.1 per cent. This provides a summary of invitation activity and participation for the outreach work covered by this report.

## Contact

Of the invitations issued, 2064 were sent with an SMS. No reminder messages were recorded, with 0 recipients receiving a reminder message.
